title: Developer earnings with less query work
summary:
Less work behind developer earnings, fewer peak-load errors for nova-fast, and a few repairs to the auth dialog and project listings.

The earnings query now calculates time buckets, per-app totals, and overall totals in one pass, reading roughly a third as many rows for a 90-day request while preserving the reported totals. `/balance/today` also caches weekly earnings for 60 seconds and returns zero earnings, rather than a 502, when the analytics service rate-limits a request.

`nova-fast` now uses a US cross-region inference profile instead of a single region, distributing requests to reduce peak-load throttling and resulting 5xx errors.

The auth modal’s amber theme and logo rendering were repaired. Unwanted outlines on the dialog container and logo link were removed without changing tab order or control focus.
